info.title: Pinuyumayan Main Site API v25 - Deployable Main Site Bridge + Review/HMAC/SEO Governance
info.description: Public-safe and internal sync API for the 卑南族文化綜合平台主站. Public endpoints return approved/verified knowledge only; internal endpoints require x-pinuyumayan-main-site-key. v10 adds readiness, job queue operations, and a stable error response contract. v11 adds API versioning, export bundle artifacts, scoped internal APIs, and sync replay. v12 adds release channels, multi-site scoped delivery, governance dashboard and search export readiness. v13 adds admin login bootstrap, main-site superadmin sync, and content collection delivery endpoints. v14 adds search suggestions/facets, cache invalidation, quality gate run hooks, admin security sessions and MFA scaffold. v15 adds delivery SLOs, contract-test runs, full corpus reconciliation, payload snapshots, search index versions and scoped admin permission grants. v18 adds source-grounded AI article planning, duplicate prevention, and human-review publication governance. v20 adds true source collection, no-duplicate frontend AI article memory, source packet delivery, and a built-in next-upgrade roadmap. v22 adds frontend AI provider adapters, client draft validation, citation/duplicate cooldown checks, HMAC nonce policy, candidate source adapters and admin review dashboard. v25 adds deployable main-site migration manifest, article review action API, HMAC verification endpoint, SEO publish checks, full corpus acceptance reporting, and v26 roadmap.
